metaTitle: Airtable to Webflow Integration Guide | B2B Sync
metaDescription: Learn how to seamlessly sync Airtable records to Webflow CMS collections with automated triggers, zero code, and Make middleware.
topUseCases: Auto-publish programmatic SEO landing pages from curated Airtable tables.
Sync multi-author blog drafts and asset attachments into Webflow CMS items.
Update product inventory and pricing on live marketing pages without designer intervention.
stepByStepGuide: Generate an Airtable Personal Access Token (PAT) with data.records:read scopes.
Create an API Token in Webflow Site Settings under the Integrations tab.
In Make (formerly Integromat), create a scenario starting with the 'Airtable - Watch Records' trigger module.
Add the 'Webflow - Create/Update Item' action module and map table fields to CMS collection schema.
Enable instant Webhook triggers in Airtable and turn on the Make scenario schedule.
commonPitfalls: Hitting Webflow's rate limit of 60 requests/minute during bulk imports from Airtable without a pacing delay.
Field type mismatches (e.g. multi-reference IDs vs plain text slugs) causing silent CMS item creation failures.

metaTitle: HubSpot to Slack Integration Guide (Native Sync)

Assign inbound leads immediately by alerting reps in designated rep channels.
Search CRM contacts and log meeting notes directly from Slack using /hubspot commands.

Click 'Install app' and authorize permissions for your target Slack workspace.
Under HubSpot Settings > Integrations > Connected Apps, configure default channel notifications.
Create a HubSpot Workflow to trigger conditional Slack channel messages based on Deal Stage updates.
commonPitfalls: Over-notifying general channels with low-priority lead changes, creating notification fatigue.
Failing to map individual HubSpot user accounts to Slack users, preventing direct @mentions in alerts.

Add a 'QuickBooks - Search Customers' module to match by email and avoid duplicate contacts.
Add a 'QuickBooks - Create a Sales Receipt' module with split lines for gross revenue and Stripe merchant processing fees.
commonPitfalls: Omitting Stripe fee line items, leading to discrepancies between bank deposits and book revenue totals.
Failing to account for refund events, resulting in overstated gross revenue numbers in QuickBooks.

metaTitle: Salesforce to Notion Integration Tutorial

Set up a Make webhook listener receiving Salesforce Outbound Messages or CDC (Change Data Capture) events.
Map Salesforce Opportunity fields (Amount, Stage, Close Date, Owner) to Notion database properties.
Add error handling paths for custom field validation and rate-limit retries.
commonPitfalls: Syncing too many granular SFDC fields into Notion, hitting database block limits and slowing Notion search.
Not accounting for Salesforce sandboxes vs production instance URLs during OAuth configuration.

metaTitle: PostgreSQL to Google Sheets Data Pipeline

Trigger alert rows whenever abnormal error counts or spikes are detected in production tables.

Set up a Make scenario using the 'PostgreSQL - Execute a Query' or 'Watch Rows' trigger module.

Provision a Google Cloud BigQuery dataset with partitioning by ingest date.

metaTitle: HubSpot to Salesforce CRM Integration Guide
metaDescription: Set up bi-directional contact syncing, lead scoring handoffs, and opportunity attribution between HubSpot Marketing Hub and Salesforce.

metaTitle: Typeform to HubSpot Lead Capture Integration Guide

metaTitle: LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms to HubSpot Sync Guide
